preconditions.description: n, m, and k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= k for a in alice_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Alice are within the range [1, k].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= k for b in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Bob are within the range [1, k].

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(sum(w_a) > sum(w_b) for w_a in permutations(alice_fish) for w_b in permutations(bob_fish)) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a permutation of Alice's fish weights that is strictly greater than any permutation of Bob's fish weights, otherwise 'NO'.
